label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off. Visit 1 produced two items of target indirect evidence: the survey team observed a long-unused field with overgrown paths, and a local teacher reported that land at the pasture edge has remained unused since an armed group camped there. Neither confirms EO, but both are target evidence; the national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance is the prescribed next step. Cancellation criteria are not met because the evidence does not establish safe use.
flags: No direct evidence of EO was reported; this is a recommendation for human sign-off, not a final decision.
The recorded accident is within 1 km, not stated to be inside the area; the zone flag and survey priority are not evidence.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1, E2.

E1.quote: The survey team saw that a field in part of the area has been left unused for years, with collapsed fences and overgrown paths, although the land around it is farmed.
E1.note: The team’s direct observation of a potentially productive but long-unused part of the area suggests possible contamination; it does not confirm EO.

E2.quote: A teacher said people stopped using the land at the edge of the pasture after an armed group camped there around 2006, and nobody has used it since.
E2.note: This is a first-hand local informant’s report of long-term non-use associated with an armed group presence, which suggests possible contamination but does not confirm EO.
